text:
**Short answer:** the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand is the best all-round pick. Prices below come from the search results and may have changed.

## My picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$80-98)**
- WIRED's top pick after testing 30+ models. It charges the iPhone at 15W and fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and newer.
- The iPhone pad tilts, works in landscape for StandBy mode, and the AirPods sit on the base.
- It lists at $109 and has been seen at $98, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. The 36W power supply is included and the warranty is 2 years.
- [Buy links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It charges at Qi2 25W, with a heavy base and a 6.6 ft cable. The power adapter is not included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station (~$40 on Amazon, normally $80)**
- It's the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 WIRED found. It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best for the nightstand: Nimble Podium ($130)**
- Your phone and watch lie flat, so the screens stay dark overnight. The pads can also pop up for StandBy or Nightstand mode. It supports Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best desk and travel stand: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99)**
- Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1. It lifts the phone about 70mm and has a 160° hinge. It folds for travel and includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.
- [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)

**Other travel options:**
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (~$80):** the compact folding pick at 15W. [WIRED's travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W ($99.99):** it has a cooling fan that you can switch off. A retailer page lists a code, PARTNER18, that takes it to about $82. I haven't verified the code myself. [ESR CryoBoost (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

## Things to check before buying
- **25W needs a newer phone.** Macworld says Qi2 25W applies to the iPhone 16 and 17 series. ESR's page narrows it to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Older iPhones get 15W.
- **25W matters little for overnight charging.** WIRED says it makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is plenty for most people.
- **Your AirPods case must support wireless charging.** Older cases don't.
- **Apple Watch fast charging** works on Series 7 and newer.

I'd go with the Belkin for most people, the ESR if you want to spend as little as possible, and the Satechi if it will sit on a desk and travel with you.
